user.title: Connect an ORA 5 account
user.description: Experimental Australia/New Zealand support. Use a dedicated GWM account with the ORA 5 shared to it. Enter your own credentials. Enabling commands permits Start and Stop; configure a six-digit vehicle PIN in the GWM app first. Signing in may displace this account on your phone.

verify.title: Verify the Home Assistant login
verify.description: Enter the verification code GWM emailed for this login. Do not enter it in the phone app.

retry.title: Sign-in was not completed
retry.description: Check the account details, connectivity and verification code, then try again.

error.invalid_pin: Enter the six-digit vehicle PIN configured in the GWM app.
error.cannot_connect: GWM sign-in failed. Check your details or try again later.

abort.no_ora5: No shared or owned ORA 5 was found on this account.
abort.account_mismatch: Use the same account when reconfiguring. Add a new integration entry for a different account.
